description: Makes a 1200x630 cover and a 512x512 thumbnail from a gameplay screenshot (e.g. desktop-input.png from gamealia_run_autotest): center-cropped with the title on a gradient. Writes cover and thumb files to outDir (refuses to replace existing ones unless overwrite:true) and returns their paths plus the cover as an image. Without game it is local only; with game (needs login) it also uploads both to that listing, replacing its current images. Otherwise pass the files to gamealia_create_game or gamealia_update_listing.

game.description: Upload them to this game's listing

outDir.description: Where to write cover/thumb (default: the screenshot's folder)

overwrite.description: Replace existing cover/thumb files in outDir

title.description: Game title drawn on the images, 1-60 characters

name: gamealia_generate_cover
title: Generate cover and thumbnail
